tools.name: site_check
tools.description: Website health, search-visibility and conversion check for any public URL. Returns a 0-100 score and a ranked list of issues, each with what was found, why it matters and the fix. About 20 checks: HTTPS and certificate, speed, mobile tag, title, description, headings, structured data, robots, sitema

tools.name: page_brief
tools.description: Page brief: give a public URL; get the page as clean markdown (headings, text, links), its title, description, language and word count, a website health score with the top issues, and which security headers are present. Fetched by us live, respects robots.txt, skips login-walled pages. Charged only

tools.name: business_verify
tools.description: Business verify: give a business domain (and optionally its name). Checks public facts only: domain age (registry record), email setup (MX, SPF, DMARC), HTTPS and certificate, and whether the name appears on the site. Returns a trust score with each signal, its source and fetch time, and warnings. N

tools.name: local_business_profile
tools.description: Company / business enrichment lookup (US). Give a business name and a city or ZIP; get the best matching business with address, phone, website, social links, category, website health score, services it publishes on its own site, and a verification block: every field lists its sources and fetched-at

tools.description: Businesses of one category near a US city, ZIP or coordinates: name, address, phone, website, social links, distance, confidence and source for each. One call returns: the matched business (Overture), phone, address and category, hours only if the business publishes them, domain age, email setup (MX/SPF/DMARC), certificate, website health and technology stack, SEC reg

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: site_check, page_brief, business_verify · Private data: site_check, business_verify · Public sink: business_verify, company_dossier.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: site_check, page_brief, business_verify · Private data: site_check, business_verify · Public sink: business_verify, company_dossier

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
